verses.gurmukhi: ਵਾਟੈ ਮਾਣਸ ਮਾਰਦਾ ਬੈਠਾ ਬਾਲਮੀਕ ਵਟਵਾੜਾ।
verses.translit_en: vaaTai maanas maaradhaa baiThaa baalameek vaTavaaRaa|

en.bdb: Valmeel was a highwayman Valmiki who would rob and kill travellers passing by.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਮਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੋਆ ਖਿੰਜੋਤਾੜਾ।
verses.translit_en: pooraa satigur bheTiaa man vich hoaa khi(n)jotaaRaa|

en.bdb: Then he began serving the true Guru, Now his mind became diffident about his work.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਨ ਨੋ ਲੋਚੈ ਘਣਾ ਕਢਿ ਨ ਹੰਘ ਹਥੁ ਉਘਾੜਾ।
verses.translit_en: maaran no lochai ghanaa kadd na ha(n)gh hath ughaaRaa|

en.bdb: His mind still urged to kill people but his hands would not obey.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਨੂਆ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਉਛੇਹਾੜਾ।
verses.translit_en: satigur manooaa raakhiaa hoi na aavai uchhehaaRaa|

en.bdb: The true Guru made his mind tranquil and all the volition of mind came to an end.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਉਗੁਣੁ ਸਭ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਅਨੁ ਰੋਜਗਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਏਹੁ ਅਸਾੜਾ।
verses.translit_en: aaugun sabh paragaasian rojagaar hai eh asaaRaa|

en.bdb: He unfolded all the evils of mind before the Guru and said, ‘O Lord, this is a profession for me.’

verses.gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਪੁਛਣ ਘਲਿਆ ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲ ਹੈ ਕੋਇ ਅਸਾੜਾ।
verses.translit_en: ghar vich puchhan ghaliaa a(n)t kaal hai koi asaaRaa|

en.bdb: The Guru asked him to enquire at home as to which family members would be co-partner him of his evil deeds at death.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋੜਮੜਾ ਚਉਖੰਨੀਐ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਬੇਲੀ ਕਰਦੇ ਝਾੜਾ।
verses.translit_en: koRamaRaa chaukha(n)neeaai koi na belee karadhe jhaaRaa|

en.bdb: But although his family were always ready to be sacrifice unto him, none of them were ready to accept responsibility.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ਉਧਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਟਪਿ ਨਿਕਥਾ ਉਪਰ ਵਾੜਾ।
verses.translit_en: sach dhiraRai udhaarian Tap nikathaa upar vaaRaa|

en.bdb: On returning, the Guru placed the sermon of truth within his heart and made him a liberated one. With a single leap he was released from the net of worldliness.
Becoming gurmukh, one becomes capable of jumping across mountains of sins.
